selection: Expanded 18-source working sample for replicated history comparisons; NGPS priority with literature anchors, no dedicated controls. Event-age/lag and class-allocation audit pending.

rule.connected_region: Component containing the most NGPS targets passing the manifold rule
rule.science_redshift: 0 < z < 0.3; P1823 retained for its optical/SPHEREx history
rule.anchors: All catalogue CLAGN in the selected component with z<0.3, W3/W4 SNR>=3, AllWISE ccf=0000 and ext_flag=0
rule.historical_comparisons: NGPS targets with z<0.3, fractions<=0.08 at all three neighborhood sizes, W3/W4 SNR>=3
rule.timing_review: Retain P9694 for its 2021–2022 optical rise and brighter state through 2025; omit P9584. See timing_audit.json.
rule.expansion: Seven documented additions from sample_expansion.json. Their measured variability and archival quality determine inclusion, not manifold membership.

interpretation: Neighborhood label fractions record pool provenance, not response phases. Eighteen is a working design with a goal of roughly six sources per history family, not a demonstrated balanced allocation or validated power calculation.
